messages.content: Let's pick up an activation funnel analysis.
Picking up an activation funnel analysis.
Sunsetting the legacy dashboard is the obvious next step. Most of the work happened inside analytics/segments.sql. The alerts this morning came from survivorship bias in the retention calculation.
Good news: instrumentation on every onboarding step made it in before the freeze. analytics/funnel.sql ended up with most of the changes. Rewrote parts of analytics/experiments.py as well.
What about an activation funnel analysis?

Having compared the options, weekly rather than daily cohorts for readability is the best fit. Good news: the event taxonomy covering fourteen product actions made it in before the freeze. Having compared the options, a seven-day activation window is the best fit.
Plan for an activation funnel analysis?

Documentation of every metric definition went smoothly in the end. A 95% confidence threshold for experiment calls beat the alternatives on every axis we care about. A segment definition for activated accounts went smoothly in the end.
Once CI passes I'll merge. The alerts this morning came from timezone mismatch splitting one day across two cohorts.

We can stop worrying about deduplication of the double-fired signup event now. A holdout group excluded from all experiments? Taken care of. Instrumenting the mobile funnel is waiting for someone to pick it up. Once CI passes I'll merge.
Excluding internal accounts from every metric beat the alternatives on every axis we care about.
Good news: the dashboard tracking the three north star metrics made it in before the freeze. I'll summarise at the end.
